content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
NORTHWIND OFFICE SUPPLIES
482 Commerce Blvd, Portland, OR 97201
billing@northwindoffice.example

                    INVOICE

Invoice No: NW-2025-0117
Invoice Date: July 14, 2025
Due Date: August 13, 2025
Currency: USD

Bill To:
  Gable & Finch Accounting LLP
  1200 SW 5th Ave, Portland, OR

--------------------------------------------------------------
 DESCRIPTION                      QTY    UNIT PRICE     AMOUNT
--------------------------------------------------------------
 Copy paper A4 80gsm (500 shts)    10        4.50        45.00
 Heavy-duty stapler                 2       12.99        25.98
 Ink cartridge, black (XL)          3       31.00        93.00
--------------------------------------------------------------
                                        Subtotal:       163.98
                                        Sales Tax (8%):  13.12
                                        TOTAL DUE:      177.10

Thank you for your business!
Payment terms: Net 30

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "NORTHWIND OFFICE SUPPLIES",
  "invoice_number": "NW-2025-0117",
  "invoice_date": "2025-07-14",
  "due_date": "2025-08-13",
  "currency": "USD",
  "subtotal": 163.98,
  "tax_amount": 13.12,
  "total": 177.10,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "Copy paper A4 80gsm (500 shts)", "quantity": 10, "unit_price": 4.50, "amount": 45.00},
    {"description": "Heavy-duty stapler", "quantity": 2, "unit_price": 12.99, "amount": 25.98},
    {"description": "Ink cartridge, black (XL)", "quantity": 3, "unit_price": 31.00, "amount": 93.00}
  ]
}
```
